title: Enquiry on a power company
titleCn: 打电话给电力公司告知搬家

paragraphs.text: Now turn to Section one. Section one. You will hear a woman phoning a power company to inform them that she is going to move to a new house. First, you have some time to look at questions one to four.
You will see that there is an example that has been done for you. On this occasion only, the conversation relating to this will be played first.
Good morning, the power company. How can I help you?
Hello. I'm phoning to tell you that I'm moving home. I'd like to find out what I need to do.
Okay. Can I have your name then, please?
Yes, it's Kate Bunsen.

The woman's name is Kate Bunsen, so Bunsen has been written in the space. Now we shall begin. You should answer the questions as you listen because you will not hear the recording a second time. Listen carefully and answer questions one to four.
Good morning, the power company. How can I help you?
Hello. I'm phoning to tell you that I'm moving home. I'd like to find out what I need to do.
Okay. Can I have your name then, please?
Yes, it's Kate Bunsen.
Right. And have you got your customer number there?
I have. It's the ten-digit number, isn't it?
Yes. It should be at the top of your last bill, if you've got that.
Thank you. I'll just bring your details up on screen. Hmm, so you're moving. Could you tell me what your new address will be, please?
Uh, yes, it's 37, Heart Street, Cambridge, and the post code's CB25LL.
Right. And when are you going to move? Have you got an exact date?
Yes, I'll be in the new place on the 21st.
Oh, that can't be July. That'd be tomorrow. So is that August?
Yes, next month. I might just be packed up by then.

It's a stressful time, isn't it? I'll just need to ask what services and products you'll be taking with you to your new home and tell you about extra help we offer, then you can go and get on with your packing.
Okay.
At the moment, we supply you with gas and electricity.
Actually, I'll just be with you for electricity. There's no mainline gas at the new place.
Right. Okay, now we're at services. I see you've had our safety checks each year at your present property. Do you want us to arrange them again for you?
Yes, I'll continue those. And I also have one of your appliance protection policies. Do I need to transfer that too?
You do, yes. Which appliance is it for?
It's just the cooker. I'm not taking the freezer with me when I move.
Okay, I'll change that for you.
Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions five to ten. Now listen and answer questions five to ten.
Now I've got all the details that I need about your new home. Next, I'll just go through what will happen when you move and tell you how we can give you some extra help.
Great.

From now on, a different department will deal with you. It's called the Home Movers Department. I'll pass your details onto them now, though I'll first have to run a credit check, which we're required to do before setting up your new account, and that will take a few days. They'll let you know when it's been completed.
Great.

Then, nearer your moving date, they'll write to you reminding you to take meter readings. That will normally be 3 days before your move. If they don't hear from you within a couple of days of the move, they'll first contact you by phone, and after that, they'll email to ensure that they get the final meter readings from your last property.
Okay.

And that's it, really. But before you go, there are additional services for moving house that we offer too. I know that one of the first things some people want to do when they move is to change the locks.
Right.
And this month, we're also promoting our central heating servicing. If you want us to do this, we're offering a special price of 85 pounds. I can send you details if you like.
Okay.
We can also send you a booklet, which is free, which will no doubt be very useful for you at this time. It tells you about how to choose the best appliances for your home. Shall I send that?
Okay. And do you have any information about energy saving that you could send too? It's an old house I'm moving to, and I'd like to see what advice you can give.
I don't have any leaflets or anything that I can give you, but if you go to our website, you'll find lots of information there.
Right, I will. Thanks for your help.
Not at all. Good luck with your move.
Thanks very much. Bye.
That is the end of Section one.
